notes.title: Workaround for potential crashes caused by Nahimic
notes.notes: Apparently there is a weird software called "Nahimic" distributed on some systems sometimes related to SteelSeries headphones that wildly injects itself into other applications and can potentially even crash them.

notes.title: First post launch patch!
notes.notes:
Fixed a couple of minor issues.
The character constantly facing in one direction while using some gamepads should be fixed.
Attempted a blind fix for crashes which some players have reported. I can't locally reproduce those unfortunately.
